Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
workup

Acid-reflux the 6.0 formulation context

Alternative formulation template; not simultaneous treatment of all three formulations. Acidic reflux enhances luminescence. HPLC, TEM, UV and XRD showed no significant change; this does not prove unchanged atomic surface chemistry. Oxidation of residual traps and Fermi-level changes are proposed explanations, not measured mechanisms.
